from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687674/attempts/fe7b32dd748346a8b1b7c0aebff056b5/system/state/workspace/programs/task-66f24338.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 >= c1:
                continue
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1, vals))
    background = Counter(v for *_, vals in regions for v in vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        if r0 >= r1:
            continue
        row_out = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            if c0 >= c1:
                continue
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            row_out.append(1 if sum(v != background for v in vals) == 2 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
'''
